title: AI Leaders Propose SAFE Guidelines for Cybersecurity Transparency
excerpt: Members of the Open Secure AI Alliance — now more than 120 organizations strong — are developing new guidelines to strengthen agentic AI cybersecurity as the annual Black Hat conference begins in Las Vegas today. The Linux Foundation today shared a Request for Comments on Shared AI Findings Exchange (SAFE), a proposed set of guidelines […]
content_html:
Members of the Open Secure AI Alliance — now more than 120 organizations strong — are developing new guidelines to strengthen agentic AI cybersecurity as the annual Black Hat conference begins in Las Vegas today. 

The Linux Foundation today shared a Request for Comments on Shared AI Findings Exchange (SAFE), a proposed set of guidelines designed to turn agentic cybersecurity incidents into shared protection for the entire ecosystem.

The SAFE guidelines are being drafted by an Open Secure AI Alliance working group. NVIDIA, Cisco, CrowdStrike, Hugging Face and Red Hat are among Open Secure AI Alliance members working with the Linux Foundation to contribute to the initial proposal.

The SAFE guidelines include proposals to confidentially collect and analyze AI incidents and near misses, inform those impacted, identify recurring control failures and publish evidence-based operating recommendations that reduce systemic risk.

Cybersecurity is a race without a finish line. Every major technology shift has created new potential attack surfaces. Defenders must move now at agent speed to respond rapidly to protect infrastructure and intellectual property — and the best way to do that is together. When trusted ecosystems share threat intelligence openly, collective defense becomes a force multiplier.

Open Secure AI Alliance Delivers More Tools for AI Cybersecurity

The SAFE framework adds to technology contributions Open Secure AI Alliance members are making to build and share open, inspectable tools across the full AI security stack.  

An AI agent isn’t just a model. It’s a system — identity controls, harnesses, guardrails, logs and evaluation — and securing it requires more than vulnerability scanning. 

Security has always been strongest in the layers — and in the community’s willingness to share what it knows. The hardest problems get solved when defenders learn from each other, openly and at speed.

Full Stack of Open NVIDIA Cybersecurity Software and Models

NVIDIA’s contributions run the length of the stack, starting with the NVIDIA Labs Object-Oriented Agent (NOOA) research harness, on GitHub — which makes agent behavior easier to test, trace, audit and govern. 

The NVIDIA OpenShell runtime restricts what an agent can see, touch and do — enforcing security and privacy controls at the agent level, so an agent can’t reach what it shouldn’t. 

NVIDIA’s open model families — NVIDIA Nemotron for agentic AI, NVIDIA Cosmos for physical AI, NVIDIA Isaac GR00T for robotics, NVIDIA BioNeMo for healthcare and life sciences, and NVIDIA Alpamayo, the world’s largest model for autonomous vehicles licensed for commercial use — ship with open weights, datasets and training techniques. 

NVIDIA open source verified agent skills extend that trust to the capability layer. 

Each skill provides portable instruction sets — cataloged, scanned for risks such as prompt injection and tools poisoning, cryptographically signed and documented with a skill card. Defenders know exactly what an agent skill does, where it came from and whether it was modified after publication.

NeMo Guardrails, NeMo Anonymizer and NeMo Safe Synthesizer help enforce safety policies, protect sensitive data and generate privacy-safe synthetic data.

And Garak, NVIDIA’s open source LLM vulnerability scanner, lets security teams check models for data leaks, prompt injections and jailbreak scenarios before they ship. 

Alliance Members Expand Tools for Open Ecosystem Development

Other members of the Open Secure AI Alliance have also been building across the full defensive stack, spanning identity and permissions, harnesses, runtime guardrails, security AI models, observability and evaluation, data security and privacy, availability and resilience, and more. 

Some of the latest contributions across different layers of the stack are highlighted below, with more continuing to arrive.

Identity and Permissions — Who Gets to Act

You can’t secure what you can’t identify. 

Okta is developing reference implementations for agent identity and access, showing how Cross App Access (XAA), an open protocol, enables AI agents operating in OpenShell sandbox environments to securely connect to enterprise applications.

Palo Alto Networks has contributed open source tools from Idira, its next-generation identity security platform, including Agent Guard and Agent Watch. These tools help developers and agent builders apply identity security best practices and safe guards such as securely retrieving secrets for agentic workflows. 

A new open source project founded by Red Hat, asago takes an organization’s custom governance requirements — such as those referenced in NIST, OWASP and the EU AI Act — and maps them directly to what agents are allowed to do at runtime, with a single audit trail from policy clause to live control.

Harnesses and Tooling — How Security Work Gets Orchestrated

AI agents are more than a model – they tap into systems of open and closed models, harnesses, tools and runtimes to get work done.

If a model is the agent’s brain, the harness is the body that takes action by using tools. The harness surrounding the model acts like an orchestrator that determines how agents are deployed, coordinated and constrained. 

Alliance members are contributing tooling, harnesses and supporting technologies across this emerging layer of the AI security stack.

Amazon, which today became one of the newest members of the Open Secure AI Alliance, contributes Strands Agents, an open source toolkit for building AI agents that is open at every layer, giving developers full visibility into agent behavior and the ability to evaluate agentic systems in production. Amazon also contributes Cedar, an open source authorization language that enforces deterministic, verifiable boundaries on what AI agents are permitted to do, giving customers fine-grained, analyzable access controls to help ensure only authorized actions reach enterprise resources.

Capital One open sourced VulnHunter for agentic AI code security.

Cloudflare is offering its Vulnerability Discovery Harness as an open source skill to add security to agent systems.

Microsoft AI Red Team has open sourced several tools and harnesses. PyRIT – Python Risk Identification toolkit enables AI red teamers to run automated red teaming, with built in memory, supporting common targets, as well as custom endpoints. 

RAMPART turns red-team findings and real-world incidents into repeatable tests that run as software changes. Clarity helps teams question design assumptions and identify potential failures before code is written.

Microsoft has also open sourced Assert, which converts natural language requirements and expected AI safety and security behaviors into executable evaluations.

Atlas is Wiz’s autonomous vulnerability research engine that orchestrates specialized AI agents to discover and validate security flaws across code and open source packages.

Visa has also joined the Open Secure AI Alliance, contributing its open sourced Visa Vulnerability Agentic Harness to help teams identify issues, support remediation and validation, quickly and safely.

Models — Intelligence Built for AI Safety and Defense

Not every security or safety task calls for a general-purpose model. Specialized security and safety models are purpose-built for defense: trained to understand code, locate vulnerabilities and reason about threats at scale. They can work to support agentic workflows as systems of models, with both open and closed models working together to get the job done efficiently.

Cisco DefenseClaw is an open source agentic governance layer that sits on top of NVIDIA OpenShell to provide robust, automated security at the runtime level when scaling agentic workforces. Cisco has also released two of its Antares security small language models to help pinpoint where known vulnerabilities exist within a codebase; and Project CodeGuard to embed secure-by-default practices directly into AI coding workflows.

CrowdStrike is fine-tuning the NVIDIA Nemotron Nano model for cyber defense. Internal testing achieved 96% accuracy in generating investigation queries within Falcon LogScale, delivering a natural-language interface that boosts agent investigative efficiency. CrowdStrike has also published research demonstrating how a specialized NVIDIA Nemotron Nano reasoning model outperforms much larger models on Security Operations Center detection triage while introducing calibrated logit-based confidence to enable measurable, tunable, and auditable autonomous security decisions.

Mistral today released its new Shieldstral multimodal safety classifier model as open weights under Apache 2.0.

Seeing what an agent did is only part of the picture. Defenders also need to understand why it acted, whether the system behaves safely and how attacks are evolving in the real world. 

Akamai brings insights from its State of the Internet reports and Security Intelligence Group research, drawing on real-world data to illuminate AI-era threats and explain how emerging exploits work so defenders can learn, adapt and respond.Cognition has released a trustworthiness evaluation, which measures alignment and security risks of open source-derived models. The evaluation demonstrates these risks can be mitigated via post-training.  

Numbat is Perplexity’s open source agent security suite for client endpoints. It detects, investigates, and prevents agent activity across macOS, Linux and Windows — giving defenders a structured record of what agents actually did.

Uber open sourced key components of ADR (Agentic AI Detection and Response), a production system that reconstructs the full causal chain of AI agent activity -– from prompt to reasoning, tool calls, and outcomes -– to help security teams detect threats. Today, ADR supports more than 200,000 agent sessions per day across 30,000 endpoints, using a two-tier analysis approach that combines efficient detection with deeper investigation for high-confidence threats. 

Availability and Resilience — Rapid Recovery When Moments Count

Agent systems must remain dependable under disruption, contain failures and recover safely without losing critical state or exposing the broader environment.

LangChain is adding resilience capabilities to its open source frameworks — Deep Agents, LangGraph and LangChain — enabling agents to retry interrupted work, follow a safe recovery path, resume from a saved state instead of starting over and automatically fall back to alternative models when the primary model fails.

Veeam helps organizations keep the data and infrastructure behind AI resilient and recoverable with technologies such as Kanister, its open source framework for data protection on Kubernetes. It helps teams protect and recover AI workloads, vector databases, and data to a verified known-good state.

More contributions are coming. When members publish reusable mitigations, defenders across the ecosystem can inspect, adapt and improve them, helping security practices evolve as AI advances.

Join members of the Open Secure AI Alliance at Black Hat today, Tuesday, Aug. 4, at 5:15pm PT, for a group photo outside the Main Stage, Business Hall at the Mandalay Bay Convention Center.

Learn more or share interest in joining the Open Secure AI Alliance.

sentences.zh: 开放安全人工智能联盟的其他成员也一直在构建完整的防御堆栈，涵盖身份和权限、安全带、运行时护栏、安全人工智能模型、可观察性和评估、数据安全和隐私、可用性和弹性等。

blocks.html_en: Some of the latest contributions across different layers of the stack are highlighted below, with more continuing to arrive.

sentences.en: Some of the latest contributions across different layers of the stack are highlighted below, with more continuing to arrive.
sentences.zh: 下面重点介绍了堆栈不同层的一些最新贡献，并且还会有更多贡献。

blocks.html_en: Identity and Permissions — Who Gets to Act

sentences.en: Identity and Permissions — Who Gets to Act
sentences.zh: 身份和权限——谁可以采取行动

blocks.html_en: You can’t secure what you can’t identify.

sentences.en: You can’t secure what you can’t identify.
sentences.zh: 你无法保护你无法识别的东西。

blocks.html_en: Okta is developing reference implementations for agent identity and access, showing how Cross App Access (XAA), an open protocol, enables AI agents operating in OpenShell sandbox environments to securely connect to enterprise applications.

sentences.en: Okta is developing reference implementations for agent identity and access, showing how Cross App Access (XAA), an open protocol, enables AI agents operating in OpenShell sandbox environments to securely connect to enterprise applications.
sentences.zh: Okta 正在开发代理身份和访问的参考实现，展示开放协议 Cross App Access (XAA) 如何使在 OpenShell 沙箱环境中运行的 AI 代理能够安全地连接到企业应用程序。

blocks.html_en: Palo Alto Networks has contributed open source tools from Idira, its next-generation identity security platform, including Agent Guard and Agent Watch. These tools help developers and agent builders apply identity security best practices and safe guards such as securely retrieving secrets for agentic workflows.

sentences.en: Palo Alto Networks has contributed open source tools from Idira, its next-generation identity security platform, including Agent Guard and Agent Watch.
sentences.zh: Palo Alto Networks 贡献了其下一代身份安全平台 Idira 的开源工具，包括 Agent Guard 和 Agent Watch。

sentences.en: These tools help developers and agent builders apply identity security best practices and safe guards such as securely retrieving secrets for agentic workflows.
sentences.zh: 这些工具可帮助开发人员和代理构建者应用身份安全最佳实践和安全防护措施，例如安全地检索代理工作流程的机密。

blocks.html_en: A new open source project founded by Red Hat, asago takes an organization’s custom governance requirements — such as those referenced in NIST, OWASP and the EU AI Act — and maps them directly to what agents are allowed to do at runtime, with a single audit trail from policy clause to live control.

sentences.en: A new open source project founded by Red Hat, asago takes an organization’s custom governance requirements — such as those referenced in NIST, OWASP and the EU AI Act — and maps them directly to what agents are allowed to do at runtime, with a single audit trail from policy clause to live control.
sentences.zh: asago 是红帽创建的一个新开源项目，它采用组织的自定义治理要求（例如 NIST、OWASP 和欧盟人工智能法案中引用的要求），并将它们直接映射到允许代理在运行时执行的操作，并提供从策略条款到实时控制的单一审计跟踪。

blocks.html_en: Harnesses and Tooling — How Security Work Gets Orchestrated

sentences.en: Harnesses and Tooling — How Security Work Gets Orchestrated
sentences.zh: 线束和工具——如何协调安全工作

blocks.html_en: AI agents are more than a model – they tap into systems of open and closed models, harnesses, tools and runtimes to get work done.

sentences.en: AI agents are more than a model – they tap into systems of open and closed models, harnesses, tools and runtimes to get work done.
sentences.zh: 人工智能代理不仅仅是一个模型——它们利用开放和封闭模型、线束、工具和运行时的系统来完成工作。

blocks.html_en: If a model is the agent’s brain, the harness is the body that takes action by using tools. The harness surrounding the model acts like an orchestrator that determines how agents are deployed, coordinated and constrained.

sentences.en: If a model is the agent’s brain, the harness is the body that takes action by using tools.
sentences.zh: 如果模型是代理的大脑，那么线束就是通过使用工具采取行动的身体。

sentences.en: The harness surrounding the model acts like an orchestrator that determines how agents are deployed, coordinated and constrained.
sentences.zh: 模型周围的线束就像一个协调器，决定如何部署、协调和约束代理。

blocks.html_en: Alliance members are contributing tooling, harnesses and supporting technologies across this emerging layer of the AI security stack.

sentences.en: Alliance members are contributing tooling, harnesses and supporting technologies across this emerging layer of the AI security stack.
sentences.zh: 联盟成员正在为人工智能安全堆栈的这一新兴层提供工具、利用和支持技术。

blocks.html_en: Amazon, which today became one of the newest members of the Open Secure AI Alliance, contributes Strands Agents, an open source toolkit for building AI agents that is open at every layer, giving developers full visibility into agent behavior and the ability to evaluate agentic systems in production. Amazon also contributes Cedar, an open source authorization language that enforces deterministic, verifiable boundaries on what AI agents are permitted to do, giving customers fine-grained, analyzable access controls to help ensure only authorized actions reach enterprise resources.

sentences.en: Amazon, which today became one of the newest members of the Open Secure AI Alliance, contributes Strands Agents, an open source toolkit for building AI agents that is open at every layer, giving developers full visibility into agent behavior and the ability to evaluate agentic systems in production.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊今天成为开放安全人工智能联盟的最新成员之一，它贡献了 Strands Agents，这是一个开源工具包，用于构建在每一层开放的人工智能代理，使开发人员能够全面了解代理行为以及评估生产中代理系统的能力。

sentences.en: Amazon also contributes Cedar, an open source authorization language that enforces deterministic, verifiable boundaries on what AI agents are permitted to do, giving customers fine-grained, analyzable access controls to help ensure only authorized actions reach enterprise resources.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊还贡献了 Cedar，这是一种开源授权语言，它对允许人工智能代理执行的操作强制执行确定性、可验证的边界，为客户提供细粒度、可分析的访问控制，以帮助确保只有授权的操作才能到达企业资源。

blocks.html_en: Capital One open sourced VulnHunter for agentic AI code security.

sentences.en: Capital One open sourced VulnHunter for agentic AI code security.
sentences.zh: 第一资本开源 VulnHunter，用于代理 AI 代码安全。

blocks.html_en: Cloudflare is offering its Vulnerability Discovery Harness as an open source skill to add security to agent systems.

sentences.en: Cloudflare is offering its Vulnerability Discovery Harness as an open source skill to add security to agent systems.
sentences.zh: Cloudflare 提供其漏洞发现工具作为一项开源技能，以增强代理系统的安全性。

blocks.html_en: Microsoft AI Red Team has open sourced several tools and harnesses. PyRIT – Python Risk Identification toolkit enables AI red teamers to run automated red teaming, with built in memory, supporting common targets, as well as custom endpoints.

sentences.en: Microsoft AI Red Team has open sourced several tools and harnesses.
sentences.zh: Microsoft AI Red Team 开源了多种工具和工具。

sentences.en: PyRIT – Python Risk Identification toolkit enables AI red teamers to run automated red teaming, with built in memory, supporting common targets, as well as custom endpoints.
sentences.zh: PyRIT – Python 风险识别工具包使 AI 红队人员能够运行自动化红队，并内置内存，支持常见目标以及自定义端点。

blocks.html_en: RAMPART turns red-team findings and real-world incidents into repeatable tests that run as software changes. Clarity helps teams question design assumptions and identify potential failures before code is written.

sentences.en: RAMPART turns red-team findings and real-world incidents into repeatable tests that run as software changes.
sentences.zh: RAMPART 将红队的调查结果和现实世界的事件转化为可重复的测试，并在软件更改时运行。

sentences.en: Clarity helps teams question design assumptions and identify potential failures before code is written.
sentences.zh: 清晰度有助于团队在编写代码之前质疑设计假设并识别潜在的故障。

blocks.html_en: Microsoft has also open sourced Assert, which converts natural language requirements and expected AI safety and security behaviors into executable evaluations.

sentences.en: Microsoft has also open sourced Assert, which converts natural language requirements and expected AI safety and security behaviors into executable evaluations.
sentences.zh: 微软还开源了 Assert，它将自然语言要求和预期的 AI 安全和安保行为转换为可执行的评估。

blocks.html_en: Atlas is Wiz’s autonomous vulnerability research engine that orchestrates specialized AI agents to discover and validate security flaws across code and open source packages.

sentences.en: Atlas is Wiz’s autonomous vulnerability research engine that orchestrates specialized AI agents to discover and validate security flaws across code and open source packages.
sentences.zh: Atlas 是 Wiz 的自主漏洞研究引擎，它协调专门的人工智能代理来发现和验证代码和开源包中的安全缺陷。

blocks.html_en: Visa has also joined the Open Secure AI Alliance, contributing its open sourced Visa Vulnerability Agentic Harness to help teams identify issues, support remediation and validation, quickly and safely.

sentences.en: Visa has also joined the Open Secure AI Alliance, contributing its open sourced Visa Vulnerability Agentic Harness to help teams identify issues, support remediation and validation, quickly and safely.
sentences.zh: Visa 还加入了开放安全人工智能联盟，贡献其开源 Visa 漏洞代理工具，帮助团队快速、安全地识别问题、支持修复和验证。

blocks.html_en: Models — Intelligence Built for AI Safety and Defense

sentences.en: Models — Intelligence Built for AI Safety and Defense
sentences.zh: 模型——为人工智能安全和防御而构建的智能

blocks.html_en: Not every security or safety task calls for a general-purpose model. Specialized security and safety models are purpose-built for defense: trained to understand code, locate vulnerabilities and reason about threats at scale. They can work to support agentic workflows as systems of models, with both open and closed models working together to get the job done efficiently.

sentences.en: Not every security or safety task calls for a general-purpose model.
sentences.zh: 并非所有安全或安全任务都需要通用模型。

sentences.en: Specialized security and safety models are purpose-built for defense: trained to understand code, locate vulnerabilities and reason about threats at scale.
sentences.zh: 专门的安全和安全模型是专门为防御而构建的：经过训练可以理解代码、定位漏洞并大规模推理威胁。

sentences.en: They can work to support agentic workflows as systems of models, with both open and closed models working together to get the job done efficiently.
sentences.zh: 他们可以将代理工作流程作为模型系统来支持，开放式和封闭式模型协同工作以高效地完成工作。

blocks.html_en: Cisco DefenseClaw is an open source agentic governance layer that sits on top of NVIDIA OpenShell to provide robust, automated security at the runtime level when scaling agentic workforces. Cisco has also released two of its Antares security small language models to help pinpoint where known vulnerabilities exist within a codebase; and Project CodeGuard to embed secure-by-default practices directly into AI coding workflows.

sentences.en: Cisco DefenseClaw is an open source agentic governance layer that sits on top of NVIDIA OpenShell to provide robust, automated security at the runtime level when scaling agentic workforces.
sentences.zh: Cisco DefenseClaw 是一个开源代理治理层，位于 NVIDIA OpenShell 之上，可在扩展代理劳动力时在运行时级别提供强大的自动化安全性。

sentences.en: Cisco has also released two of its Antares security small language models to help pinpoint where known vulnerabilities exist within a codebase; and Project CodeGuard to embed secure-by-default practices directly into AI coding workflows.
sentences.zh: 思科还发布了两个 Antares 安全小语言模型，以帮助查明代码库中存在已知漏洞的位置； Project CodeGuard 将默认安全实践直接嵌入到人工智能编码工作流程中。

blocks.html_en: CrowdStrike is fine-tuning the NVIDIA Nemotron Nano model for cyber defense. Internal testing achieved 96% accuracy in generating investigation queries within Falcon LogScale, delivering a natural-language interface that boosts agent investigative efficiency. CrowdStrike has also published research demonstrating how a specialized NVIDIA Nemotron Nano reasoning model outperforms much larger models on Security Operations Center detection triage while introducing calibrated logit-based confidence to enable measurable, tunable, and auditable autonomous security decisions.

sentences.en: CrowdStrike is fine-tuning the NVIDIA Nemotron Nano model for cyber defense.
sentences.zh: CrowdStrike 正在对用于网络防御的 NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 模型进行微调。

sentences.en: Internal testing achieved 96% accuracy in generating investigation queries within Falcon LogScale, delivering a natural-language interface that boosts agent investigative efficiency.
sentences.zh: 内部测试在 Falcon LogScale 内生成调查查询的准确率达到 96%，提供了可提高代理调查效率的自然语言界面。

sentences.en: CrowdStrike has also published research demonstrating how a specialized NVIDIA Nemotron Nano reasoning model outperforms much larger models on Security Operations Center detection triage while introducing calibrated logit-based confidence to enable measurable, tunable, and auditable autonomous security decisions.
sentences.zh: CrowdStrike 还发表了研究成果，展示了专门的 NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 推理模型如何在安全运营中心检测分类方面优于更大的模型，同时引入基于 Logit 的校准置信度以实现可测量、可调节和可审核的自主安全决策。

blocks.html_en: Mistral today released its new Shieldstral multimodal safety classifier model as open weights under Apache 2.0.

sentences.en: Mistral today released its new Shieldstral multimodal safety classifier model as open weights under Apache 2.0.
sentences.zh: Mistral 今天发布了新的 Shieldstral 多模式安全分类器模型，作为 Apache 2.0 下的开放权重。

blocks.html_en: Seeing what an agent did is only part of the picture. Defenders also need to understand why it acted, whether the system behaves safely and how attacks are evolving in the real world.

sentences.en: Seeing what an agent did is only part of the picture.
sentences.zh: 看到特工做了什么只是图片的一部分。

sentences.en: Defenders also need to understand why it acted, whether the system behaves safely and how attacks are evolving in the real world.
sentences.zh: 防御者还需要了解其行为的原因、系统是否安全运行以及攻击在现实世界中是如何演变的。

blocks.html_en: Akamai brings insights from its State of the Internet reports and Security Intelligence Group research, drawing on real-world data to illuminate AI-era threats and explain how emerging exploits work so defenders can learn, adapt and respond.Cognition has released a trustworthiness evaluation, which measures alignment and security risks of open source-derived models. The evaluation demonstrates these risks can be mitigated via post-training.

sentences.en: Akamai brings insights from its State of the Internet reports and Security Intelligence Group research, drawing on real-world data to illuminate AI-era threats and explain how emerging exploits work so defenders can learn, adapt and respond.Cognition has released a trustworthiness evaluation, which measures alignment and security risks of open source-derived models.
sentences.zh: Akamai 带来了其互联网状况报告和安全情报小组研究的见解，利用真实世界的数据来阐明人工智能时代的威胁，并解释新兴漏洞如何发挥作用，以便防御者能够学习、适应和响应。Cognition 发布了可信度评估，用于衡量开源衍生模型的一致性和安全风险。

sentences.en: The evaluation demonstrates these risks can be mitigated via post-training.
sentences.zh: 评估表明这些风险可以通过培训后得到缓解。

blocks.html_en: Numbat is Perplexity’s open source agent security suite for client endpoints. It detects, investigates, and prevents agent activity across macOS, Linux and Windows — giving defenders a structured record of what agents actually did.

sentences.en: Numbat is Perplexity’s open source agent security suite for client endpoints.
sentences.zh: Numbat 是 Perplexity 面向客户端端点的开源代理安全套件。

sentences.en: It detects, investigates, and prevents agent activity across macOS, Linux and Windows — giving defenders a structured record of what agents actually did.
sentences.zh: 它可以检测、调查和阻止跨 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 的代理活动，为防御者提供有关代理实际操作的结构化记录。

blocks.html_en: Uber open sourced key components of ADR (Agentic AI Detection and Response), a production system that reconstructs the full causal chain of AI agent activity -– from prompt to reasoning, tool calls, and outcomes -– to help security teams detect threats. Today, ADR supports more than 200,000 agent sessions per day across 30,000 endpoints, using a two-tier analysis approach that combines efficient detection with deeper investigation for high-confidence threats.

sentences.en: Uber open sourced key components of ADR (Agentic AI Detection and Response), a production system that reconstructs the full causal chain of AI agent activity -– from prompt to reasoning, tool calls, and outcomes -– to help security teams detect threats.
sentences.zh: Uber 开源了 ADR（代理人工智能检测和响应）的关键组件，这是一个生产系统，可以重建人工智能代理活动的完整因果链——从提示到推理、工具调用和结果——以帮助安全团队检测威胁。

sentences.en: Today, ADR supports more than 200,000 agent sessions per day across 30,000 endpoints, using a two-tier analysis approach that combines efficient detection with deeper investigation for high-confidence threats.
sentences.zh: 如今，ADR 每天支持跨 30,000 个端点的超过 200,000 个代理会话，采用两层分析方法，将高效检测与对高可信度威胁进行更深入的调查相结合。

blocks.html_en: Availability and Resilience — Rapid Recovery When Moments Count

sentences.en: Availability and Resilience — Rapid Recovery When Moments Count
sentences.zh: 可用性和弹性 — 在关键时刻快速恢复

blocks.html_en: Agent systems must remain dependable under disruption, contain failures and recover safely without losing critical state or exposing the broader environment.

sentences.en: Agent systems must remain dependable under disruption, contain failures and recover safely without losing critical state or exposing the broader environment.
sentences.zh: 代理系统必须在中断时保持可靠、包含故障并安全恢复，而不会丢失关键状态或暴露更广泛的环境。

blocks.html_en: LangChain is adding resilience capabilities to its open source frameworks — Deep Agents, LangGraph and LangChain — enabling agents to retry interrupted work, follow a safe recovery path, resume from a saved state instead of starting over and automatically fall back to alternative models when the primary model fails.

sentences.en: LangChain is adding resilience capabilities to its open source frameworks — Deep Agents, LangGraph and LangChain — enabling agents to retry interrupted work, follow a safe recovery path, resume from a saved state instead of starting over and automatically fall back to alternative models when the primary model fails.
sentences.zh: LangChain 正在为其开源框架（Deep Agents、LangGraph 和 LangChain）添加弹性功能，使代理能够重试中断的工作，遵循安全的恢复路径，从保存的状态恢复而不是重新开始，并在主模型失败时自动回退到替代模型。

blocks.html_en: Veeam helps organizations keep the data and infrastructure behind AI resilient and recoverable with technologies such as Kanister, its open source framework for data protection on Kubernetes. It helps teams protect and recover AI workloads, vector databases, and data to a verified known-good state.

sentences.en: Veeam helps organizations keep the data and infrastructure behind AI resilient and recoverable with technologies such as Kanister, its open source framework for data protection on Kubernetes.
sentences.zh: Veeam 借助 Kanister（Kubernetes 上用于数据保护的开源框架）等技术，帮助组织保持 AI 背后的数据和基础设施的弹性和可恢复性。

sentences.en: It helps teams protect and recover AI workloads, vector databases, and data to a verified known-good state.
sentences.zh: 它可以帮助团队保护 AI 工作负载、矢量数据库和数据并将其恢复到经过验证的已知良好状态。

blocks.html_en: More contributions are coming. When members publish reusable mitigations, defenders across the ecosystem can inspect, adapt and improve them, helping security practices evolve as AI advances.

sentences.en: More contributions are coming.
sentences.zh: 更多贡献即将到来。

sentences.en: When members publish reusable mitigations, defenders across the ecosystem can inspect, adapt and improve them, helping security practices evolve as AI advances.
sentences.zh: 当成员发布可重复使用的缓解措施时，整个生态系统的防御者可以检查、调整和改进它们，帮助安全实践随着人工智能的进步而发展。

sentences.en: Join members of the Open Secure AI Alliance at Black Hat today, Tuesday, Aug. 4, at 5:15pm PT, for a group photo outside the Main Stage, Business Hall at the Mandalay Bay Convention Center.

sentences.en: Learn more or share interest in joining the Open Secure AI Alliance.
sentences.zh: 了解更多信息或分享加入开放安全人工智能联盟的兴趣。

content_html_zh:
随着年度黑帽会议今天在拉斯维加斯开幕，开放安全 AI 联盟的成员（现已拥有 120 多个组织）正在制定新的指导方针，以加强代理 AI 网络安全。

Linux 基金会今天分享了一份关于共享 AI 调查结果交换 (SAFE) 的征求意见稿，这是一套拟议的指南，旨在将代理网络安全事件转变为整个生态系统的共享保护。

SAFE 指南由开放安全人工智能联盟工作组起草。 NVIDIA、思科、CrowdStrike、Hugging Face 和 Red Hat 等开放安全 AI 联盟成员与 Linux 基金会合作，为初步提案做出了贡献。

国家外汇管理局的指导方针包括建议秘密收集和分析人工智能事件和未遂事件，通知受影响的人，识别反复出现的控制故障，并发布基于证据的操作建议，以降低系统性风险。

网络安全是一场没有终点线的竞赛。 每一次重大技术变革都创造了新的潜在攻击面。 防御者现在必须以特工的速度采取行动，快速做出反应，以保护基础设施和知识产权——而做到这一点的最佳方法是共同努力。 当可信的生态系统公开共享威胁情报时，集体防御就成为力量倍增器。

开放安全人工智能联盟为人工智能网络安全提供更多工具

SAFE 框架增加了开放安全人工智能联盟成员在整个人工智能安全堆栈中构建和共享开放、可检查工具的技术贡献。

人工智能代理不仅仅是一个模型。 这是一个系统——身份控制、安全带、护栏、日志和评估——保护它需要的不仅仅是漏洞扫描。

安全性始终在各个层面以及社区分享其所知的意愿中最为强大。 当防守者公开、快速地相互学习时，最困难的问题就会得到解决。

全栈开放式 NVIDIA 网络安全软件和模型

NVIDIA 的贡献贯穿整个堆栈，首先是 GitHub 上的 NVIDIA 实验室面向对象代理 (NOOA) 研究工具，这使得代理行为更易于测试、跟踪、审计和管理。

NVIDIA OpenShell 运行时限制代理可以看到、触摸和执行的操作 - 在代理级别强制执行安全和隐私控制，因此代理无法执行不应执行的操作。

NVIDIA 的开放模型系列——用于代理 AI 的 NVIDIA Nemotron、用于物理 AI 的 NVIDIA Cosmos、用于机器人技术的 NVIDIA Isaac GR00T、用于医疗保健和生命科学的 NVIDIA BioNeMo，以及全球最大的获得商业用途许可的自动驾驶汽车模型 NVIDIA Alpamayo——均附带开放权重、数据集和训练技术。

NVIDIA 开源经过验证的代理技能将这种信任扩展到了能力层。

每种技能都提供便携式指令集 - 进行编目、扫描提示注入和工具中毒等风险、使用技能卡进行加密签名和记录。 防御者确切地知道特工技能的作用、它的来源以及发布后是否被修改。

NeMo Guardrails、NeMo Anonymizer 和 NeMo Safe Synthesizer 帮助执行安全策略、保护敏感数据并生成隐私安全的合成数据。

Garak 是 NVIDIA 的开源 LLM 漏洞扫描程序，可让安全团队在模型发货前检查模型是否存在数据泄露、提示注入和越狱情况。

联盟成员拓展开放生态系统开发工具

开放安全人工智能联盟的其他成员也一直在构建完整的防御堆栈，涵盖身份和权限、安全带、运行时护栏、安全人工智能模型、可观察性和评估、数据安全和隐私、可用性和弹性等。

下面重点介绍了堆栈不同层的一些最新贡献，并且还会有更多贡献。

身份和权限——谁可以采取行动

你无法保护你无法识别的东西。

Okta 正在开发代理身份和访问的参考实现，展示开放协议 Cross App Access (XAA) 如何使在 OpenShell 沙箱环境中运行的 AI 代理能够安全地连接到企业应用程序。

Palo Alto Networks 贡献了其下一代身份安全平台 Idira 的开源工具，包括 Agent Guard 和 Agent Watch。 这些工具可帮助开发人员和代理构建者应用身份安全最佳实践和安全防护措施，例如安全地检索代理工作流程的机密。

asago 是红帽创建的一个新开源项目，它采用组织的自定义治理要求（例如 NIST、OWASP 和欧盟人工智能法案中引用的要求），并将它们直接映射到允许代理在运行时执行的操作，并提供从策略条款到实时控制的单一审计跟踪。

线束和工具——如何协调安全工作

人工智能代理不仅仅是一个模型——它们利用开放和封闭模型、线束、工具和运行时的系统来完成工作。

如果模型是代理的大脑，那么线束就是通过使用工具采取行动的身体。 模型周围的线束就像一个协调器，决定如何部署、协调和约束代理。

联盟成员正在为人工智能安全堆栈的这一新兴层提供工具、利用和支持技术。

亚马逊今天成为开放安全人工智能联盟的最新成员之一，它贡献了 Strands Agents，这是一个开源工具包，用于构建在每一层开放的人工智能代理，使开发人员能够全面了解代理行为以及评估生产中代理系统的能力。 亚马逊还贡献了 Cedar，这是一种开源授权语言，它对允许人工智能代理执行的操作强制执行确定性、可验证的边界，为客户提供细粒度、可分析的访问控制，以帮助确保只有授权的操作才能到达企业资源。

第一资本开源 VulnHunter，用于代理 AI 代码安全。

Cloudflare 提供其漏洞发现工具作为一项开源技能，以增强代理系统的安全性。

Microsoft AI Red Team 开源了多种工具和工具。 PyRIT – Python 风险识别工具包使 AI 红队人员能够运行自动化红队，并内置内存，支持常见目标以及自定义端点。

RAMPART 将红队的调查结果和现实世界的事件转化为可重复的测试，并在软件更改时运行。 清晰度有助于团队在编写代码之前质疑设计假设并识别潜在的故障。

微软还开源了 Assert，它将自然语言要求和预期的 AI 安全和安保行为转换为可执行的评估。

Atlas 是 Wiz 的自主漏洞研究引擎，它协调专门的人工智能代理来发现和验证代码和开源包中的安全缺陷。

Visa 还加入了开放安全人工智能联盟，贡献其开源 Visa 漏洞代理工具，帮助团队快速、安全地识别问题、支持修复和验证。

模型——为人工智能安全和防御而构建的智能

并非所有安全或安全任务都需要通用模型。 专门的安全和安全模型是专门为防御而构建的：经过训练可以理解代码、定位漏洞并大规模推理威胁。 他们可以将代理工作流程作为模型系统来支持，开放式和封闭式模型协同工作以高效地完成工作。

Cisco DefenseClaw 是一个开源代理治理层，位于 NVIDIA OpenShell 之上，可在扩展代理劳动力时在运行时级别提供强大的自动化安全性。 思科还发布了两个 Antares 安全小语言模型，以帮助查明代码库中存在已知漏洞的位置； Project CodeGuard 将默认安全实践直接嵌入到人工智能编码工作流程中。

CrowdStrike 正在对用于网络防御的 NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 模型进行微调。 内部测试在 Falcon LogScale 内生成调查查询的准确率达到 96%，提供了可提高代理调查效率的自然语言界面。 CrowdStrike 还发表了研究成果，展示了专门的 NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 推理模型如何在安全运营中心检测分类方面优于更大的模型，同时引入基于 Logit 的校准置信度以实现可测量、可调节和可审核的自主安全决策。

Mistral 今天发布了新的 Shieldstral 多模式安全分类器模型，作为 Apache 2.0 下的开放权重。

看到特工做了什么只是图片的一部分。 防御者还需要了解其行为的原因、系统是否安全运行以及攻击在现实世界中是如何演变的。

Akamai 带来了其互联网状况报告和安全情报小组研究的见解，利用真实世界的数据来阐明人工智能时代的威胁，并解释新兴漏洞如何发挥作用，以便防御者能够学习、适应和响应。Cognition 发布了可信度评估，用于衡量开源衍生模型的一致性和安全风险。 评估表明这些风险可以通过培训后得到缓解。

Numbat 是 Perplexity 面向客户端端点的开源代理安全套件。 它可以检测、调查和阻止跨 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 的代理活动，为防御者提供有关代理实际操作的结构化记录。

Uber 开源了 ADR（代理人工智能检测和响应）的关键组件，这是一个生产系统，可以重建人工智能代理活动的完整因果链——从提示到推理、工具调用和结果——以帮助安全团队检测威胁。 如今，ADR 每天支持跨 30,000 个端点的超过 200,000 个代理会话，采用两层分析方法，将高效检测与对高可信度威胁进行更深入的调查相结合。

可用性和弹性 — 在关键时刻快速恢复

代理系统必须在中断时保持可靠、包含故障并安全恢复，而不会丢失关键状态或暴露更广泛的环境。

LangChain 正在为其开源框架（Deep Agents、LangGraph 和 LangChain）添加弹性功能，使代理能够重试中断的工作，遵循安全的恢复路径，从保存的状态恢复而不是重新开始，并在主模型失败时自动回退到替代模型。

Veeam 借助 Kanister（Kubernetes 上用于数据保护的开源框架）等技术，帮助组织保持 AI 背后的数据和基础设施的弹性和可恢复性。 它可以帮助团队保护 AI 工作负载、矢量数据库和数据并将其恢复到经过验证的已知良好状态。

更多贡献即将到来。 当成员发布可重复使用的缓解措施时，整个生态系统的防御者可以检查、调整和改进它们，帮助安全实践随着人工智能的进步而发展。
